Epic: bd-01M1Z987V50254M59P9MNGP9FH
Delivery phase: 6 of 6; child 11 of 12.
Design: docs/design/interaction.md; full snapshot retained in the epic note.
Status: planned work; no implementation or passing evidence is asserted.

Scope
Add bounded spatial indexing and incremental updates while preserving batch identity and the shared picking/state contract. Characterize 10,000-mark SVG and 100,000-point Canvas workloads and set measured release budgets before accepting performance claims.

Acceptance criteria
1. Indexed results agree with the exhaustive picking oracle under overlap, clipping, and transformations; indexes invalidate correctly on geometry/revision changes.
2. Updates preserve entity selections and refresh only affected rendering/index work where supported; no hidden full-statistic recomputation is labeled incremental.
3. Record hardware/browser, retained memory, index build cost, pointer-to-highlight latency, redraw latency, and disposal behavior for the stated fixtures.
4. Establish explicit measured budgets and fail their dedicated gate on regression; fixture sizes alone are not an advertised capacity guarantee.
5. Caches/indexes have bounded ownership and release resources when controllers dispose. Record analytic-membership costs separately when that capability is enabled.

Exclusions
Unmeasured universal latency/capacity promises or weakening identity/picking correctness to hit a benchmark.

Required evidence
Reproducible benchmark inputs/harness and recorded measurements, oracle comparisons, lifecycle memory checks, and exact source/artifact identifiers.
Retain tested source SHA, fixture inputs, expected outputs, and actual gate results. Pending or unavailable checks remain explicitly pending.

Prerequisites
bd-01M1Z9B3FPJXKAYSYYF1DF7Q9M

Coordination
Reserve only actual files when implementation starts. Parent containment is not a prerequisite on the epic; do not create a child-to-epic dependency cycle.
set.title: [Intaglio][Interaction 11] Measure and improve batch picking, redraw, and incremental updates
